description: How a Claude-side MCP tool-call maps onto MhsClient::write. The McpMhs transport (Phase 215) sends this as a JSON-RPC 2.0 'tools/call' over stdio or HTTP. The same trace works for CliMhs and HttpMhs.

agent_loop.purpose: TICK — advance the machine control loop

error_classes.SafetyViolation: do NOT retry; the device refused because the value is outside the declared envelope
error_classes.GrantRequired: issue mhs.hold_grant for destructive channels before re-issuing mhs.write
error_classes.Aborted: device is latched; an operator must call mhs.clear_abort (off-trait) before any further writes
